speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Twenty shillings on the board. Count them, and then count them again. It is before noon, and I will have it before noon.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I am writing you the receipt in my late husband's law-hand. You may look at the hand if you do not trust the total. You may not correct the hand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not correct it. You have the twenty shillings.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The candles this quarter came to more than the quarter's bread. I have never before had a lodger of whom that was true.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then it is true of me. I will not argue a candle into a loaf.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. The receipt is yours. Take it upstairs with you, and do not make me say the sum a third time.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have it. Thank you, Mistress. The board is clear of my silver.
